# research/ package index

One row per package directory under `research/`. Generated 2026-10-20 (Pacific) from each package's own
README / PREREGISTRATION / RESULT / registration files and
[CAMPAIGN_LOG.md](../docs/research/final_run_20261019/CAMPAIGN_LOG.md). This index is descriptive only: it
grants no authority, and the binding documents remain those listed in [docs/STATUS.md](../docs/STATUS.md)
"Campaign authority". Many packages are hash-bound by ratified studies; do not edit them to match this file.

**Status key.** RATIFIED-FROZEN = registered/ratified or qualified, bytes bound, not to be edited.
RUNNING = live run in progress. DRAFT = built or registered as draft, not ratified/dispatched.
RESULT-RECORDED = a verdict is recorded in the package or the campaign log. HISTORICAL = completed earlier
work with no current decision role (verdict, if any, lives in docs/ or artifacts, not this package).
UNUSED = prepared but never launched per its own files. unclear = package files do not say.

**Counts (117 packages):** HISTORICAL 86, RESULT-RECORDED 18, RATIFIED-FROZEN 4, unclear 3, RUNNING 2, UNUSED 2, DRAFT 2.
